scope: One deterministic execution of the normalized, exact-real held model, evaluated in float64. No parameter sweep or hardware validation.

recipe.index_convention: n starts at 0; patterns repeat by n modulo 2
recipe.requested_input: -x_n - 3*v_n - 2*a_n, computed at the sample and held
recipe.actual_held_input: clipped_input + w_n; disturbance enters after the clamp
recipe.evaluation: float64 with math.exp and math.expm1; analytic segment endpoints define the recurrence; no ODE integrator
recipe.dense_grid_rule: ceil(duration/max_spacing) evenly spaced local points excluding right endpoint; append final endpoint once; rational clock before float conversion

observation_limit: Dense-grid extrema are maxima over the finite evaluation grid, not certified continuous-time extrema. The analytic Lean theorem supplies universal safety.

render_review.result: Three panels, legends, initial clipping annotation and numerical-evidence footer are legible; footer/x-label collision corrected in final render.
